title: SafeBox class with password
statement: Define a SafeBox class with a private attribute password and a constructor that takes it, and an Open method that takes an attempt and returns 1 if it matches the password or 0 if not. Read the password and then an attempt, create the object and write the result of calling Open.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with a class.
The statement asks the password to be a private attribute.
